assumptions: Prices are in INR for India; a price from another market is converted at the ECB rate of its day and marked converted.
Replacement cost is a new copy of the same work, the same format where the edition is known; used value is a second-hand listing in the condition it states.
Any line priced at or above 100,000 INR, and anything the identifier judged rare, signed, antiquarian or first edition, goes to appraisal unpriced.
Identified lines with confidence under 0.8 are kept and also listed in the review queue.
Spine sizes come from known-size objects located in the same frame (an A4 sheet, catalogue heights of identified books); a book's own catalogue height is left out of its measurement.
Frames the frame model judged blurred or dark were not read.
Item width and height come from the same frame scale, only for objects the reader placed at the depth of the spines; depth is not measured.

Room sizes come from an A4 sheet lying on the floor: floor points through its homography, heights through the camera pose it gives; wall area is perimeter times ceiling height less openings of at least 0 m2.
The live session is billed from the tokens the Live API reports per turn, at list prices per modality; other stages from each call's tokens and searches.
